headline: Gold Rises Nearly 2% as Oil Prices Slump and Fed Rate Path Monitored
summary: Gold closed higher, reversing recent losses, driven by optimism over Middle East peace talks and ongoing market monitoring of the Federal Reserve's future interest rate trajectory.
why: Gold frequently trades inversely to risk sentiment and real yields, serving as a traditional hedge against macroeconomic uncertainty and shifting monetary policy expectations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Shift in market risk sentiment and monetary policy expectations support safe-haven demand for gold.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Optimism surrounding potential Middle East resolutions and speculation on Federal Reserve rate trajectories prompted a rebound in precious metal demand.
